name: Akupara Multi-Sided Monsters
summary:
Polyhedral Dice Meets Monster Taming

Combine dice-crafting tactics with cozy creature collection in two standout strategy roguelikes published by Akupara Games!

This bundle pairs two deeply tactical, deckbuilding-inspired experiences:

Astrea: Six-Sided Oracles: Build a pool of custom polyhedral dice in a die-building roguelike. Master the dual Purification and Corruption system, trigger powerful chain reactions, and command loyal Sentinels to cleanse cosmic corruption.

Montabi: Train, tame, and battle alongside adorable companions in a cozy monster-collecting deckbuilder. Position your creatures across a 3x3 grid, draft food cards, and execute clever team synergies.

Roll your dice, build your deck, and master two unique takes on tactical roguelite combat!
